analysis.reason:

RSI는 과매도 구간(32.8)에서 벗어나 중립 구간(47.1)으로 진입했으나, 여전히 50 이상 강세 전환 미확인.

ATR 1,988원 대비 손절폭 1.3배(2,584원) 설정 시, 진입가 31,665원 기준 손절 29,081원, 목표가 35,750원(손익비 1.5 이상) 설정 가능하나, 명확한 추세 전환 신호 부재로 관망 유지.
analysis.reasonEn:
The wait-and-see stance continues for the third consecutive trading day.
RSI has moved out of oversold territory (32.8) into neutral (47.1), but has not yet confirmed a move above 50.
MACD histogram has turned positive from negative, showing improvement, but a potential dead cross with the signal line remains.
Weekly ADX at 25.4 indicates a clear trend, but on the daily chart, the price is still at 37.4% of the 52-week low.
With an ATR of 1,988 KRW, a stop loss of 1.3x ATR (2,584 KRW) from the entry price of 31,665 KRW would be 29,081 KRW, and a target price of 35,750 KRW (risk/reward > 1.5) is feasible, but a clear trend reversal signal is absent, thus maintaining a wait-and-see approach.

· Swing Resistance (34,850 KRW): Close to SMA50 (34,630 KRW), potential for medium-term trend reversal upon breakout.
· 5-day/20-day High/Low Pattern (Higher Low): Higher lows indicate a recovery signal.
[Volume & Conclusion]
· Volume Ratio (1.04x): Average volume suggests moderate confidence in price movement.
· Current phase diagnosis (Accumulation): Maintaining a wait-and-see approach due to lack of clear trend reversal signals; 4H RSI at 41.3 shows a similar weak trend to the daily chart.
